descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
Flight Simulator Calgary puts you in the captain's seat over the real Calgary.

THE REAL CALGARY
Real satellite, elevation and map data: the Calgary Tower, the Saddledome, Stampede Park, the Peace Bridge, the Centre Street Bridge, Prince's Island, Canada Olympic Park, the Glenmore Reservoir and the Bow and Elbow rivers. The Rockies rise in the west: fly up the Bow valley past Canmore to Banff. Two airports: Calgary International and Springbank.

A LIVING CITY
CTrains on the Red and Blue lines, freight trains on the main line, thousands of cars, airliners in the sky, grain elevators and pump jacks on the prairie. At night the city lights up, with fireworks over Stampede Park.

AIR TRAFFIC CONTROL
A real-sounding radio: taxi and takeoff clearances, departure, traffic calls, the ILS and your landing clearance, with chatter between airliners.

YOUR GLASS HANGAR
Every flight starts in your glass hangar by the rivers, the Calgary Tower out of the doors. Walk around, repaint, wash, fly.

FOUR AIRCRAFT
Two private jets with walk-through cabins, a midsize jet with yokes and a twin-engine fighter.

MISSIONS AND FREE FLIGHT
Eleven missions: the downtown approach, Springbank, the Bow River run, through the skyline, a Rockies run to Banff, a fighter scramble, Stampede nights and a Calgary tour.

FLY TOGETHER ONLINE
Quick Match or a private sky with a code. Voice chat stays off until you turn it on.
